messages:
Noelle - AE: Quick heads-up: Arbor Labs requested a 10-day POC to validate a customer-fine-tuned 13B variant + embeddings. Requirements: streaming chat, embeddings, SAML SSO, and HIPAA scope. They plan to use customer-managed KMS.
Ravi - Sales Eng: Do we know artifact format/quant? LoRA/adapters?
Noelle - AE: They said qlora export in safetensors with tokenizer.json and an adapter.safetensors.
Yara - ML Eng: qlora + safetensors usually ok but needs a compatibility run. I'll kick off `compat-scan arbor-13b.tar.gz --quick` and simulate streaming.
InfraBot: Capacity check: pool "poc-west-1" has 2x A100 spare for that window. :white_check_mark:
Yara - ML Eng: Scan results: tokenizer loads but 11 OOV tokens to map; model loads but attention kernel mismatch at block 10 -> adapter shim required. ETA for shim + tests: 48h + 24h validation. Streaming p50 after tuning ~95-120ms on A100.
Ravi - Sales Eng: Timeline and risk noted. Pricing suggestion for 10-day POC: $3,900 reserved + $0.65 per 1k tokens over baseline, provisional pending compat sweep.
Samir - Security: HIPAA requires Dedicated/Private and signed BAA/DPA before PHI. BYOK supported on Private; need KMS ARN and key policy + SOC2 attestation. I'll send a short security checklist.
Noelle - AE: I'll ask Arbor to return signed DPA/BAA and KMS info within 3 business days to keep schedule.
Yara - ML Eng: Created ENG-8801 for adapter shim, tokenizer mapping, and streaming regression tests. Will attach customer's sample queries and perf matrix.
Ravi - Sales Eng: Action items: Noelle to collect legal/KMS, Samir to circulate sec questionnaire, Yara to post ENG updates, Ravi to send provisional SOW and kickoff invite.
Noelle - AE: I'll update this thread with customer replies. Also flagging: if shim work delays >5 business days we should revisit scope/pricing. :memo:
